title: Xuanzang
subtitle: Pilgrim, translator and Tripiṭaka master of Great Ci'en Monastery
shortSummary: Xuanzang connects a pilgrimage for learning with translation and institutional life in Chang'an.
curatorialDescription: Xuanzang matters not only because he travelled far, but because he transformed encounters in India and Central Asia into translation, teaching and institutional work in Chang'an.
The museum separates his journeys, translations, lineages and later narratives instead of compressing biography, legend and historical evidence into one story.
researchNote: This Alpha content source still needs item-level references to editions, translation projects and route waypoints.
